issues.legal_issue: A notification urbanizing rural land under Section 507(a) of the Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957 causes the provisions of the Delhi Land Reforms Act, 1954 to cease to apply to that land.
Proceedings pending under the Delhi Land Reforms Act, 1954 become non est after the land is urbanized by notification under Section 507(a) of the Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957.
The Supreme Court may, under Article 142 of the Constitution, direct delivery of possession to achieve complete justice in the circumstances of a case.
